20043.meta_title: Game Wizard Xtreme Coin Operated Version
20043.product_name: Game Wizard Xtreme Coin Operated Version
20043.long_desc: The Game Wizard Xtreme Coin Operated Edition features everything you love about our original Game Wizard Xtreme and has now been upgraded to include our New Coin Operated Timer Control Panel built in. Offering endless gaming options, it is compatible with XBbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PC, Raspberry Pi, Android, JAMMA Boards, JVS late model arcade game boards and more. It is all plug and play with no additional modifications or wiring needed. Continuous firmware updates means the machine will be upgradable for the latest consoles. Game Wizard Xtreme Coin Operated Edition is built as an industry-leading step forward in arcade gaming for both home and commercial use. This machine creates a true arcade experience with 1ms HD gaming monitor, Sanwa joystick and buttons, 2.1 audio sound system with subwoofer, Jamma, JVS arcade and full console/PC support. What makes Game Wizard Xtreme Coin Operated Edition so great and versatile is that you can keep updating your machine with free firmware updates (to update to current consoles/hardware if supported) as well as adding various add-ons and panel changes. This is a dynamic machine, it will be as “fresh” and modern as the day you purchased. Our older Version 1.0 customers can simply buy the latest panels and upgrade their machines to current series. Play with friends around the world, record your sessions and stream with full media support for Youtube, Twitch, Discord, Skype and more. Firmware updates are constantly being released to support the latest consoles and software and drive enhanced performance. Register your Arcooda machine online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum. Make your Xtreme Coin Operated Edition unique with Arcooda's product builder. Customise button layouts, colour schemes, hardware and more. Key features on the Xtreme Coin Operated Edition arcade machine include; TIMER PANEL: The coinop operated timer control panel is designed exclusively for the Game Wizard Xtreme. It allows coin operation for arcade games, consoles, PC and more. Highly suitable for internet cafes and rentals where customers can add their own game accounts to the machine and rent the game cabinet from you on time. MONITOR: supports 15khz, 31khz, and up to 1080P HD inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. This monitor has been designed for arcade gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: Xtreme Coin Operated Edition arcade machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. CABINET: Up to 2mm powdercoated steel construction, with acrylic panels. Internally, the machine is layered allowing you to update your machine at any time with the Arcooda Game Wizard add-on, or add your own internal functions. With industry standard wheels and screw down feet, Xtreme Coin Operated Edition arcade also includes 6 input power board, 3.3V 12A , 5V 20A, 12V 9A power supply, separate 12V power supply, 2x 12volt fans, and EMI filter. WIRING: The cabinet is designed with Jamma wiring system. The machine supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard wiring system CONTROL PANEL: comes with the standard Xtreme v1.0 arcade 2 player, 8 buttons and 2 trackballs per side. Thats not all, the panel is customisable, you can remove whole control panel and swap to one of our many other Control Panel setups available in our arcade parts section Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. On Screen Images are for demonstration purposes only. GameBoard is not included with the purchase of this machine
